[[File:Hoth-ST.png|thumb|250px|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a planet for hover-skiing]]
'''Hover-skiing''' was a type of adventure sport practiced on snow. [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was one of the destinations for hover-skiing enthusiasts.<ref name="Disney">{{Disney|url=star-tours-adventures/hoth|text=Star Tours Adventures: Destinations - Hoth|nolive=1}}</ref>

The interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] was known for taking hover-skiing and [[ice-boarding]] enthusiasts to snowy planets like Hoth to enjoy the sport.<ref name="Disney" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] always wanted to go hover-skiing down the side of an exploding [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]].<ref name="QOTE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>
